threads.body: `is_copilot_review()` currently uses a broad substring heuristic (`"copilot" in login` + `endswith("[bot]")` or contains `pull-request-reviewer`). This can misclassify unrelated bots/users that happen to include "copilot" in their login (and any bot ending with `[bot]`), causing the dashboard to show a ✅ for non-Copilot reviews. Consider matching the expected reviewer bot login explicitly (e.g., `copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]`), or using an allowlist of known Copilot reviewer accounts to avoid false positives.
threads.hunk:
@@ -556,6 +556,23 @@ def ts_text(ts: datetime | None) -> str:
     return ts.isoformat() if ts else ""
 
 
+def is_copilot_review(review: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    login = actor_login(review.get("user") or {}).lower()
+    if not login:
+        return False
+    return "copilot" in login and (login.endswith("[bot]") or "pull-request-reviewer" in login)
